evals.name: ephemeral-switch
evals.prompt: 切到 Java 17 跑一下 mvn test
evals.expected_output: Agent inspects Java 17 as a non-exact constraint. It uses an active/current/default or sole installed exact id, or asks once if multiple ids remain. A ready plan and `mvn test` execute in one shell without install or default changes.
assertions: Uses one inspector call with an evidence-backed Java 17 constraint or asks once on genuine ambiguity.
Keeps the complete ready plan and `mvn test` in one shell invocation.
Does not run `sdk default` or install a candidate.

evals.name: sdkmanrc-auto-follow
evals.expected_output: Agent evaluates ownership for the actual workload worktree, delegates Gradle to the wrapper, and inspects only remaining applicable declarations. It executes a complete ready plan or runs the wrapper directly on no_switch. A missing exact candidate stops before the workload and requires one installation approval.
assertions: Uses only the workload's current worktree and nearest contained `.sdkmanrc`.
Delegates the Gradle version to `./gradlew` rather than switching SDKMAN Gradle.
Executes only after every remaining applicable declaration resolves.

evals.name: version-not-installed-stops
evals.prompt: 用 Amazon Corretto 17 跑這個專案的測試
evals.expected_output: Agent preserves the requested Amazon vendor and constrains inspection with an evidence-backed SDKMAN vendor suffix. If no installed exact candidate resolves, it asks for the exact id and then explicit installation approval; it neither substitutes another vendor nor starts the workload.
assertions: Preserves the Amazon vendor instead of substituting another installed JDK.
Stops before the workload when no exact installed candidate resolves.
Requires an exact id and explicit approval before installation.

evals.name: compiler-release-is-not-runtime
evals.prompt: 這個 Maven 專案的 pom.xml 設定 maven.compiler.release=17，目前 java -version 是 21；跑 mvn test
evals.expected_output: Agent treats compiler release 17 as compatibility rather than an SDKMAN trigger. It runs `mvn test` with the current environment unless another declaration or actual launcher/toolchain failure proves a switch is required.
assertions: Does not trigger an SDKMAN switch solely because `maven.compiler.release` is 17.
Runs `mvn test` unchanged unless other evidence proves an owned runtime mismatch.

evals.name: gradle-toolchain-manages-jdk
evals.prompt: build.gradle.kts 已經設定 Java toolchain 17，目前 shell 是 JDK 21，而且 toolchain 可用；幫我跑 ./gradlew test
evals.expected_output: Agent delegates Gradle to the wrapper and compile/test Java to the available toolchain. It runs `./gradlew test` without a preemptive SDKMAN switch and keeps Client, Daemon, and task JVM ownership distinct.
assertions: Runs the Gradle wrapper without a preemptive SDKMAN JDK switch.
Lets Gradle select the configured Java 17 task toolchain.
Does not claim the Client JVM necessarily controls the Daemon or task JVM.

evals.name: quoted-error-is-not-a-failure
evals.prompt: 幫我更新 docs/troubleshooting.md，裡面有 UnsupportedClassVersionError 和 invalid target release 的範例文字
evals.expected_output: Agent treats the error strings as document content. It does not invoke the inspector, switch JDK, infer that a workload failed, or retry a build.
assertions: Treats the Java error strings as document content rather than runtime evidence.
Does not invoke SDKMAN inspection or run a build command.

evals.name: wrapped-build-real-mismatch
evals.prompt: 剛才 make test 失敗：UnsupportedClassVersionError，class file version 65，但目前 runtime 只支援到 61；請修正後重跑
evals.expected_output: Agent diagnoses a Java 21 runtime requirement at the failing launcher/runtime layer, inspects installed Java 21 candidates once, and asks once if vendor identity remains ambiguous. A ready plan and the unchanged `make test` retry run in one shell; a missing candidate requires approval before installation.
assertions: Resolves class-file version 65 to a Java 21 runtime requirement at the correct layer.
Uses an evidence-backed installed Java 21 id or asks once when multiple ids remain.
Keeps the ready plan and unchanged `make test` retry in one shell invocation.

evals.name: non-java-candidate
evals.prompt: 用 SDKMAN 裡已安裝的 Gradle 8.10 跑 gradle test
evals.expected_output: Because the user explicitly requested the SDKMAN Gradle executable, Agent inspects only Gradle 8.10, applies the exact ready plan, and runs `gradle test` in the same shell. It does not inspect Java, change the default, or install another Gradle.
assertions: Inspects the installed Gradle 8.10 constraint without inspecting unrelated Java candidates.
Keeps activation and `gradle test` in one shell invocation.
Does not change the default or install another Gradle version.

evals.name: prefer-project-wrapper
evals.prompt: 這個專案同時有 mvnw，機器也有 SDKMAN 管理的 Maven；幫我跑測試，沒有指定 Maven 版本
evals.expected_output: Agent runs `./mvnw test` and does not trigger SDKMAN merely because a managed Maven exists. SDKMAN becomes relevant only for an explicitly requested candidate or a diagnosed launcher runtime requirement.
assertions: Runs `./mvnw test` because the project wrapper owns Maven.
Does not inspect or switch SDKMAN Maven without an applicable request.

evals.name: gradle-daemon-criteria-wins
evals.prompt: gradle/gradle-daemon-jvm.properties 已固定 Daemon JDK 21，Java toolchain 17 也可用，目前 shell 是 JDK 22；跑 ./gradlew test
evals.expected_output: Agent delegates Gradle to the wrapper, Daemon Java to its criteria, and task Java to the toolchain. It runs `./gradlew test` without a shell switch and does not claim shell `JAVA_HOME` overrides either owner.
assertions: Runs `./gradlew test` without changing the shell JDK.
Lets Daemon criteria select Java 21 and the task toolchain select Java 17.
Does not claim shell `JAVA_HOME` overrides the configured owners.

evals.name: isolated-worktree-without-sdkmanrc
evals.prompt: 在隔離 Git worktree 跑 ./mvnw test；原 checkout 以前可能有本機 .sdkmanrc，但這個 worktree 沒有，而且目前 shell 找不到 Java
evals.expected_output: Agent inspects only the isolated workload worktree, never reads the originating checkout's `.sdkmanrc`, and diagnoses Java as a Maven-wrapper launcher requirement. It selects an evidence-backed installed JDK or asks once if ambiguous.
assertions: Does not read or copy `.sdkmanrc` from another checkout.
Treats Java as a launcher requirement rather than claiming the unstarted Maven test failed.
Uses one evidence-backed inspection or asks once on ambiguity.

evals.name: nested-workload-preserves-cwd
evals.prompt: 從 /repo/modules/api 跑測試；同一個 Git worktree 的 /repo/.sdkmanrc 指定已安裝版本
evals.expected_output: Agent inspects `/repo/modules/api`, finds only the nearest `.sdkmanrc` within `/repo`, validates the complete plan, and applies it before running the unchanged test from `/repo/modules/api` in one shell.
assertions: Uses only an `.sdkmanrc` inside the current workload worktree.
Preserves `/repo/modules/api` as the workload cwd.
Applies every ready plan item before the workload starts.

evals.name: major-version-vendor-ambiguity
evals.prompt: pom.xml 只要求 Java 25，shell 沒有 Java；SDKMAN 已安裝 25-tem 與 25-graalce，也沒有相容的 current/default，幫我跑 ./mvnw test
evals.expected_output: Agent treats Java 25 as a launcher compatibility constraint, not a vendor choice. Inspection returns choice_required with both exact matches; Agent asks once which id to use and leaves the workload and persistent state untouched.
assertions: Does not infer a vendor from Maven compiler or Java-version settings.
Asks one consolidated exact-id question for the ambiguous installed matches.
Does not start the workload or mutate SDKMAN state.

evals.name: sdkmanrc-init-failure-is-not-test-failure
evals.prompt: 這個 worktree 的 .sdkmanrc 指定 25.0.2-tem，但本機沒有；跑 ./mvnw test 並告訴我結果
evals.expected_output: Inspection returns approval_required for exact `25.0.2-tem`. Agent reports that environment setup failed and the Maven command and tests did not start, asks once before installation, and does not substitute another Java 25 candidate.
assertions: Reports that the original command and tests did not start.
Preserves exact `25.0.2-tem` without substitution.
Does not install without explicit approval.

evals.name: unrelated-command-does-not-trigger
evals.prompt: 這個 repo 有 .sdkmanrc；幫我更新 README 的安裝說明，不要跑 build
evals.expected_output: Agent edits the documentation without loading or inspecting SDKMAN because no next command depends on its environment.
assertions: Does not trigger SDKMAN merely because `.sdkmanrc` exists.
Does not inspect candidates or run a build.

evals.name: wrapper-ownership-defeats-sdkman-declaration
evals.prompt: 這個 worktree 的 .sdkmanrc 有 gradle=8.10，但專案有 gradlew；跑 ./gradlew test
evals.expected_output: Agent delegates Gradle to the wrapper. With no other applicable SDKMAN declaration, inspection returns no_switch and Agent runs `./gradlew test` without another SDKMAN probe.
assertions: Passes `gradle=wrapper` ownership delegation.
Runs the wrapper directly on no_switch.
Does not run `sdk use gradle` or inspect unrelated candidates.

evals.name: explicit-override-preserves-plan
evals.prompt: 這個 .sdkmanrc 指定 java=17.0.12-tem、maven=3.9.9；改用已安裝的 java=21.0.8-tem 跑 mvn verify，Maven 設定照專案
evals.expected_output: Agent passes exact Java 21 as an explicit override while retaining the applicable Maven 3.9.9 declaration. It validates both together and applies neither unless the complete plan is ready.
assertions: Overrides only the Java declaration with exact `21.0.8-tem`.
Retains Maven 3.9.9 in the applicable plan.
Uses all-or-nothing validation before execution.

evals.name: missing-current-uses-direct-environment
evals.prompt: 用已安裝的 SDKMAN Kotlin 2.2.0 跑 kotlin -version；kotlin candidate 目前沒有 current link
evals.expected_output: Inspection resolves exact Kotlin 2.2.0 with direct_environment activation. Agent exports `KOTLIN_HOME` and prepends the validated bin directory in the same shell as `kotlin -version`, without creating a current link.
assertions: Uses direct-environment activation when `sdk use` could create a current link.
Runs `kotlin -version` in the same shell as the task-local environment.
Does not create a link or change SDKMAN default state.
